headline: GOLD SLUMPS TO 2-MONTH LOW: US Strikes Iran, Inflation Dread Wipes Out $120/oz in 48 Hours
snippet: Spot gold fell 1.7% to $4,380 per ounce Thursday — its lowest since late March — as fresh U.S. strikes on Iran pushed oil higher and reignited rate-hike bets, paradoxically undermining gold's status as an inflation hedge in a high-rate environment.

headline: COBRE PANAMA AUDIT DROPS TODAY: Panama to Decide Fate of World's Biggest Idle Copper Mine
snippet: Panama's environment minister confirmed the long-awaited independent audit of First Quantum's shuttered Cobre Panamá copper mine will be released publicly Friday, triggering the presidential decision on whether to restart one of the world's largest copper operations — which produced 350,000 tonnes in 2022 — or shut it down permanently.

headline: AUSTRALIA EXPELS CHINA: Six China-Linked Entities Ordered to Dump Northern Minerals Rare Earth Stakes
snippet: Australia's Treasurer invoked the Foreign Acquisitions and Takeovers Act to force six China-linked shareholders to divest a combined 17.6% stake in Northern Minerals within two weeks — the second forced divestment targeting the dysprosium-and-terbium miner after three earlier targets defied the 2024 order by transferring shares to related parties rather than selling on market.

headline: ZIJIN/ALLIED GOLD: C$5.5B Africa Deal Hits May 29 Outside Closing Date With Regulatory Clearances Pending
snippet: Zijin Gold's C$5.5 billion acquisition of Allied Gold (C$44 per share cash) — which would add three large open-pit gold mines across Mali, Côte d'Ivoire, and Ethiopia — reaches its contractual outside closing date today with all shareholder and court approvals secured but multi-jurisdiction regulatory sign-off still in progress.

headline: SUREBET SCALE-UP: Goliath Resources Mobilizes Fully Funded 50,000m Expansion Drill in BC's Golden Triangle
snippet: Goliath Resources has mobilized rigs for a fully funded 50,000-metre systematic expansion campaign at the Surebet discovery on its Golden Triangle property in British Columbia, targeting lateral and depth extensions to what the company calls a district-scale polymetallic system in one of Canada's most prolific gold-silver belts.

headline: Prospector Metals Drills Into TESS Zone Expansion — 25,000m Underway at Yukon Gold-Silver-Copper Find
snippet: Prospector Metals has commenced a fully funded 25,000-metre diamond drill program at its ML project in Yukon, targeting expansion of the high-grade TESS Zone gold-silver-copper discovery into untested strike and depth extensions in a jurisdiction seeing renewed junior exploration interest.

headline: 23.6m AT 2.13 g/t FROM SURFACE: Axo Metals Hits Shallow Oxide Gold at San Antonio, Sonora
snippet: Axo Metals Corp. (TSXV: AXO) reported first drill assays from its San Antonio project in Sonora, Mexico — including 23.6 metres grading 2.13 g/t gold equivalent starting directly at surface — an oxide intercept the company says validates strong heap-leach potential in a proven Mexican mining district adjacent to major infrastructure.

headline: Newmont vs. SSR Mining: One Holds $7.3B in Free Cash Flow, the Other Has Zero Debt — Who Wins the Dip?
snippet: With gold testing two-month lows, Motley Fool's head-to-head compares Newmont's scale and record $7.3B 2025 free cash flow against SSR Mining's debt-free balance sheet and upcoming $1.5B Copler mine sale — asking which financial profile matters more when sentiment sours and the metal corrects.

headline: RECORD CASH FLOW SETUP: Gold Is Down From Its All-Time High. Miners Are Still Printing Money.
snippet: Gold miners are generating operating margins near $2,800/oz even as spot gold has retreated $200+ from all-time highs — with industry-wide all-in sustaining costs holding below $2,000/oz, the spread between price and production cost is at historic highs and creating a counterintuitive value setup for patient buyers.

headline: GoldSeek Asian Metals: Gold, Silver, Copper Technical Setups Still Bullish Despite Iran-Driven Selloff
snippet: GoldSeek's Asian markets wrap examines technical and fundamental setups for gold, silver, and copper following the Iran-driven pullback, arguing that key support levels are holding, the primary bull trend remains intact, and the silver-to-gold ratio is flagging a notable asymmetric opportunity for precious metals investors.
